_about: Public-domain Simon Patrick (1626-1707), Bishop of Chichester and then of Ely, for the Word Hoard: his Works including his autobiography (Oxford University Press, 1858, nine volumes), his paraphrase of Ecclesiastes and the Song of Solomon (1685), and his Old Testament commentaries from Genesis to Kings in early printings (1699-1705), from Internet Archive scans. Patrick was a Latitudinarian of the Cambridge circle and a devotional writer. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 40 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

_alternates.patrick-copies: Other scans of the 1858 Works (Princeton, Illinois, Google) and of the commentaries (1695-1705 printings); the 1822 and 1845 Patrick-Lowth-Arnald-Whitby Critical Commentary, a joint work in which his part is the Old Testament historical books; separate 19th-century reprints of the Heart's Ease, Discourse concerning Prayer, Treatise of Repentance and Advice to a Friend, all contained in the Works

_excluded.patrick-other: John Smith's Select Discourses (1660, 1859), which Patrick edited and preached the funeral sermon for; on john-smith-platonist
